purpose: Per CEO R303 P0+P1+P8: 'Build a common engine: CandidateSpec → MechanismModel → ... → BuyerFeedbackSchema → RequirementGenerator. Each candidate supplies domain-specific adapters. This is how we get from one working candidate to fifteen without fifteen separate software projects. Define BUYER_RUNNABLE rigorously.'
constitutional_basis: Article XXXV (closed-loop epistemic control). Article XXVIII (no silent semantic promotion — BUYER_RUNNABLE requires evidence, not claims). Article X (canonical state).

transitions.DISCOVERED → MECHANISM_DEFINED: Requires: specific physical mechanism described, falsifiable claim identified
transitions.MECHANISM_DEFINED → MODEL_RUNNING: Requires: executable model exists in repository (Python/CAD/simulation), can be run by third party
transitions.MODEL_RUNNING → ADVERSARIAL_TESTED: Requires: strongest comparator identified, attack suite executed, results documented
transitions.ADVERSARIAL_TESTED → VALIDATED: Requires: model survived attacks OR was repaired (V2), evidence ledger complete with provenance
transitions.VALIDATED → BUYER_RUNNABLE: Requires: ALL 10 BUYER_RUNNABLE conditions met (see P8 below)
transitions.BUYER_RUNNABLE → BUYER_TESTED: Requires: external buyer has actually executed/evaluated the package
transitions.BUYER_TESTED → ITERATING: Requires: buyer feedback entered AI loop as structured evidence
transitions.ITERATING → TRANSACTION_READY: Requires: buyer has sufficient evidence to negotiate (WTP indicated or offer made)
transitions.any → KILL: Requires: fatal blocker identified with EXPERIMENTALLY_MEASURED or validated-model evidence

P0_production_state_machine.anti_jump_rule: No candidate may silently skip states. Each transition requires documented evidence. Article XXVIII.

P1_candidate_factory_engine.description: A common engine that processes any candidate through the full loop. Each candidate supplies domain-specific adapters.

pipeline.output: list of evidence needed (what would prove/disprove the mechanism)
attack suite (failure modes, disturbances, adversarial conditions)
pipeline.adapter: domain-specific (physics attacks, biology attacks, engineering attacks)

pipeline.output: structured provenance record for every claim

pipeline.adapter: generic (feedback → requirement mapping) + domain-specific (specific experiment design)

P1_candidate_factory_engine.reusability: The generic parts (EvidenceLedger, Falsification, BuyerFeedbackSchema, Metrics) are shared across all 15. The domain-specific parts (MechanismModel, AttackGenerator, Comparator) are adapters unique to each candidate. This prevents 15 separate software projects.

P8_buyer_runnable_definition.rule: A candidate becomes BUYER_RUNNABLE only when ALL 10 conditions are true:

conditions.verification: file exists, can be cloned and run
README or equivalent with step-by-step instructions
all input parameters documented with units, ranges, defaults
all output metrics documented with units, interpretation
CI assertion: same input → same output across runs
documented weaknesses, boundary conditions, failure modes

conditions.condition: Buyer can independently inspect the result
conditions.verification: blinded protocol or open data that buyer can verify without trusting us

P8_buyer_runnable_definition.no_marketing_override: No marketing language can override these conditions. Article XXVIII.

P2_working_artifact_plan.principle: Every candidate needs an actual working artifact — not a description, not a skeleton, not a JSON dossier. An executable model that a buyer can run.
